map: hmcp_backyard -- a small house with a walled garden behind it. The prose half of this brief is brief.md, beside it.

rules.note: Two people meeting at a doorway should not have to take turns.
A room whose widest point is narrow is a corridor that has been mislabelled.
Every place a person can stand, indoors or out. The garden's ceiling is the sky.
About 15 m2. Below that it is a cupboard, not a room -- and a yard that small is a light well.
Somebody stands at the sink to use it. 48 units is one person.
What the door is for. Traced with the door removed -- the tracer sees no props.
You go through the kitchen to reach the garden. That is what puts the garden behind the house rather than beside it.
